explanation: The eta point (W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi=90 deg) passed kinematic preflight. The requested vcut=-0.1 was retained; EXCLURAD interprets negative values using its internal v convention, rather than as a positive inelasticity cut. The eta lookup-table grid could not be scanned, so its coverage was not independently verified. Input uses the validated eta campaign default beam energy of 6.53 GeV and full O(alpha) radiative corrections.
